name: Aura Material Cycler
author: harshith
description: Adaptive desktop environment with Material You wallpaper palettes, atmospheric weather effects, ASUS Aura synchronization, and GPU-aware protection against resource pressure.

barWidget.description: Dynamic Material You wallpaper, weather atmosphere, ASUS Aura sync, and GPU-aware performance protection

schema.label: Rotation Interval (seconds)
schema.description: Time in seconds between automatic wallpaper rotations. New installs default to 5 minutes to reduce CPU/GPU and network load.

schema.label: Weather-Adaptive Wallpapers
schema.description: Automatically match wallpaper theme and lighting to current outdoor weather conditions.

schema.label: Liquid Glass Blur (px)
schema.description: Compositor background blur intensity in pixels.

schema.label: Stream Fresh 4K Online
schema.description: Download authentic 4K/UHD wallpapers from Wallhaven and Bing archives when explicitly enabled.

schema.label: GPU Auto-Protect
schema.description: When explicitly enabled in the panel, pause material cycling during critical GPU VRAM or temperature pressure and resume only if Aura paused it.
